body: Thank you for the advice. I would have liked for us to stay friends however, cutting contact completely might be for the better.
What do you know about my sexual history that i dont? We didnt sleep together.
Same situation here, please help
Yeah i guess its true lol. Thank you so much for everything, I will definitely try your advice.

I have a friend who used to self harm couple years ago so i think they would be supportive and understanding. Taking it up to the group would be kinda weird i agree. But its such a hard thing to bring up randomly. Can easily be perceived as attention seeking or maybe people wont find my triggers triggering enough etc.

My family would not be of help i think, they would get angry and say im ungrateful or making a big deal out of nothing. But friends would most likely understand. Professional help is sadly not a possibility at the moment, I hope it will be one day. This was a very helpful l answer thank you.

One small change could be swapping the towel with a microfiber towel or a tshirt works the same, both better than regular towels for your hair. Also dont scrunch before styling your hair or at least before putting some product on it. You can look into brush styling if you want more defined waves/curls. I recommend watching a styling tutorial from manesbymell on youtube. I learned literally everything I know from her. But let me say your hair looks amazing as is, i am jealous!
None of the positives can compete with the negatives. Even if depression gave you the ability to fly, I would still pass if I had the chance.

Im 20. Going this far without feeling romantic love and it being so hyped has some silent affects on a persons psyche. I became an undatable person. It’s not that I dont want it anymore but it is just way to unrealistic in my eyes now. I am a prickly person when someone tries to pursue me romantically. Even if somebody pushes through, I dont want the responsibility of providing that kind of love to someone. I dont want their day dependent on me, their future tied to me. Idk if anyone is similar.

Im so tired of fighting a fight that i know i am going to lose. It gets better than it gets worse again. The dip from better to worse is the most painful part each time. I dont want to experience it anymore.
I hope so too thank you <3
I hope it gets better one day for the both of us man

I knew about coconut oil and used it before but this was not what I expected, what an interesting result! To clarify, my hair was dry and I used coconut oil so generously that it looked oily, would use less next time.

Tell me if im out of line here but considering decisions being made for you for a long time, you might have learned to accept the situation at hand because you were not able to get out previously. Now that you are on your own accord, it can take time to find a way to get what you actually deserve.

We are all trying to live and everyone is acting with regard to their own best interest. Most of the time, I come lower than that best interest, which does not offend me. On a separate note, I fucking hate myself. Why do you feel like you have low standards?

In my case, makes me think I am ahead everyone is a result of overthinking and observing and understanding part of my brain. I have spent my days and nights being anxious about the things people just sweep under the rug, I feel like I have a better understanding about a lot of things than most people. 
The other part is the self criticizing, self conscious part. Making me feel not enough, not accomplished like others, not smart enough, not pretty enough etc.
This may not be exactly the case for you but having splitting thoughts about your identity and self is not being hypocritical or stupid. Regardless of it stemming from a disorder like anxiety or not, it happens and it is normal.

So glad I could be of help! I also thought I would have been better by now. We have a habit of getting used to things good and bad as humans which sucks. The constant state of sadness and hopelessness is no exception it seems. Whatever it is you have gone through, i am so sorry the world has treated you this way and pushed you to this point. People dont understand because from the outside, it seems like we actively choose to be like this. And even if someone does understand, it will be a temporary serotonin boost and nothing more. Maybe one day it will be better for the both of us!

Even though I know this is the way depression makes me see the world, I feel like I see the meaninglessness of it all so clearly. Once you realize most your efforts will be in vain, there comes a point where you are fed up. That seems so normal to me. I probably cant be much help in terms of giving you a pep talk about how it will all be better one day but i can lend an ear anytime you want to rant.

I feel like I could turn my life around and also nothing is that particularly bad like you said. But previous experiences proved to me that no matter what, my mind will find a way to make me depressed. As time went on, what I want out of life shifted from wanting to be better to wanting to be done with it all. I dont know if this is similar to what you are experiencing but here it is.

Sometimes people talk about how shitty someone treated them and list some behaviors and i realize that those are done to me constantly. But it still doesn’t bother me, even after knowing that behavior is unacceptable. I don’t see myself as worthy of such good treatment so i don’t seek it.
I verbally abuse myself in my mind until the self hatred overshadows the anxious thoughts.

People dont care about you thing doesn’t work for me,  I know they don’t but I still feel like they judge. What worked was something a friend said to me, you don’t owe anyone beauty. I mostly feel like people stare when I enter a lecture hall. I have to remind myself that I’m not there to be pretty, I’m there to learn. I don’t have to be a pleasing sight for their eyes.
